scope: First curated PLA/PETG imports of STAR PLAST and Filamentarno!; schema_version unchanged (1).

star_plast.manufacturer_sku_status: exact per-color official 1 kg / 1.75 mm SKU
star_plast.notes: Manufacturer describes production palette as RAL-based but individual variant pages do not publish their exact RAL identifiers; never guess an RAL or HEX by shade name. Transparent and fluorescent variants keep distinct appearance lines.

filamentarno.manufacturer_sku_status: not available on browsed official catalog pages; do not invent
filamentarno.numeric_color_status: exact-line/name third-party display estimates only, never manufacturer or measured
filamentarno.selection: Only shades appearing in both the current official Filamentarno! manufacturer catalog and the pinned third-party JSON. The third-party PLA+ red, PETG gray and PETG natural have not been imported, because an exact current official line/color identity was not independently confirmed.

unimported_items: STAR PLAST additional official standard, PLA HS, Silk and translucent variants pending exact numeric color/optics
Filamentarno! PLA+ pink, orange, violet, yellow and ivory missing source-backed numeric swatches
Filamentarno! PETg transparent/Lumi variants need hue and optical/emissive separation before visual import
quality_policy: Manufacturer variants and SKUs are factual product identity; label all third-party HEX as estimated. Never promote estimated to manufacturer or measured and never infer transparency from a 2D screen HEX.
